column1: # Seconds each unit of tools/e2e_android.sh takes on the CI emulator, read by
# tools/e2e_shards.py to balance the shards e2e.yml runs at once. Each is the
# faster of the v1.0.112 and v1.0.113 gates, a unit's steps summed (a failed
# flow's timeouts inflate the slower run). A unit missing here counts as 120 s
# and runs all the same; each shard uploads what its units took, as
# durations-<run>-android-<shard>, to bring this up to date from.
